records.text: Before Charlie Kirk's death, I took our children to the Turning Point USA office pretty much daily or every other day.

appearances.snippet: But before all of this, I used to take the kids to the office pretty much daily—sometimes, because Gigi (Charlie and Erika Kirk's daughter; full name unconfirmed) would have dance class and stuff like that... ... every other day, whatever.
